## What changes?

Describe the problem and the behavior after this change. Link a public issue if useful.

## How was it checked?

List relevant checks and their results. For interface changes, include screenshots with personal information removed.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] I have removed credentials, recovery phrases, activation keys, private files, and personal data from this change and its screenshots/logs.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the submitted code and assets under the applicable project terms.
- [ ] I have noted any changes to permissions, encryption, stored data, dependencies, or deployment behavior.

Report vulnerabilities through [private security reporting](https://github.com/maqboolahmed24/projectTracker/security/advisories/new), not a public pull request or issue.
